messages:
Priya (VP Infra): follow-up from the infra segment  posting a short Q&A for regional GPU capacity, fallbacks, and autoscale knobs. ask short questions and well reply.

Rosa (SRE): short one  when a region falls below burst credits, do we try reprovision first or immediately route cross-region? need exact sequence for runbook.

Arjun (Capacity): sequence = consume burst credits -> attempt warm-pool scale-up (if available) -> reprovision from regional reserve (~60-120s) -> cross-region fallback. will add to runbook.

Tom (Platform): saw priming-triggered scale yesterday. can priming jobs be ignored by the autoscaler?

Arjun (Capacity): yes  were tagging priming traffic (traffic.tag=priming) and adding an ignore threshold of 5% cluster capacity so priming doesn't force scale-outs.

Leah (Finance): ballpark cost for keeping 2 warm nodes in an APAC zone vs on-demand? need number for monthly budget slide.

Priya (VP Infra): ballpark ~6-9k/month per zone (SKU dependent). Tom will publish exact sims by Friday for finance.

Rosa (SRE): rollback behaviour question: if a canary breaches thresholds, is rollback immediate? what are the thresholds?

Priya (VP Infra): immediate rollback on safety breaches: error-rate > 5% OR latency > 2x SLA. for softer signals we run the canary window and take controlled action. will add thresholds to the runbook doc.

Tom (Platform): H100 pilot status? customers asking about Dedicated opt-in timing.

Arjun (Capacity): partners expect initial H100 capacity next quarter. plan: small pilot cohort in week 1, Dedicated opt-in ~4 weeks after arrival after telemetry checks.

Rosa (SRE): autoscaler hysteresis  any change to avoid flapping during bursts?

Arjun (Capacity): adding dual-hysteresis: a smoothing window (60s) and a backoff (10m) after scale events. plus priming tag ignore.

Priya (VP Infra): actions: 1) Tom: publish finance sims by Fri. 2) Arjun: add priming tag + annotate dashboard. 3) Priya: update runbook thresholds and post model-eligibility note. will consolidate into all-hands notes.

Tom (Platform): linking draft sheet soon.

Leah (Finance): thanks  will review once posted.

Priya (VP Infra): thanks all  small follow-ups here; bigger asks in #eng-oncall. closing thread after actions are tracked.
